quote: It brings nothing new besides upgraded visuals. It feels more like a DLC to me. Worst of all, its fanbase is almost cult-like, refusing to tolerate any negative criticism.

author: sevenyoung
quote: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time Remake is a loving, respectful reimagining of an all-time classic. It keeps the timeless story, brilliant dungeon design and magical atmosphere of the N64 original, while bringing gorgeous 60fps visuals, refined controls, re-orchestrated music and voice acting. The streamlined quality-of-life tweaks, including the much-improved Water Temple, make it friendly for new players without stripping away its soul. It is the definitive way to experience this landmark adventure, though veterans may find it a little easier than the original.
game_title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time
